dedupe_keys.name: funsnm t4 1 synthetic district heating network data based on aalborg

description: This data set holds synthetic district heating networks with simulated hourly flows and temperatures, based on actual data from the city of Aalborg, Denmark. It was published by Peter Østergaard for task 4.1 of the FunSNM project (22DIT02), funded by the European Partnership on Metrology with Horizon Europe and participating states. Networks are auto-generated with set insulation for the service pipes and described in network JSON files, while hourly flow and temperature files give values at every junction of each network and at the tap-off to each house. Coverage is synthetic networks modelled on Aalborg at hourly resolution. The data are one ZIP of about 384 MB on Zenodo (July 2026) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: networks and flows are generated, not surveyed or metered, and the Zenodo page gives only a short description of how they were produced. Simulation uses are hydraulic and thermal network simulation, and testing of monitoring and metering methods in district heating. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
